title: Enhancement: Nexthop SKUs - Disable dumping FPGA state in `show tech`
author: lotus-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

On Nexthop platforms, avoid dumping full FPGA state on `show tech`

### Current Behavior

Currently we dump full FPGA state on `show tech`
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/platform/broadcom/sonic-platform-modules-nexthop/common/debug-dump/nh_fpga_dump

### Proposed Behavior

Although it provides more debug information, the action may be disruptive, it is safer to avoid doing so, although we have not seen actual problems in practice.
